response.sql: WITH event_counts AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance GROUP BY link_to_event), shares AS (SELECT event_id, attendance_count, 1.0 * attendance_count / NULLIF(SUM(attendance_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM event_counts) SELECT event_id, attendance_count, share FROM shares ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC LIMIT 10;
